build_task_scene: build a PHYRE task scene with a jar, static bar obstacle, and ball using the creator library
create_dynamic_objects: create dynamic jar and ball objects in the PHYRE scene using C.add with scale and position parameters
create_static_obstacle: create a static bar obstacle in the PHYRE scene positioned above the jar using C.add
update_task_goal: update the PHYRE task goal to place the ball inside the jar using C.update_task with INSIDE relationship
define_task_decorator: define a new PHYRE task using the creator_lib.define_task decorator to register the build_task function
